### Fixed
- **Switching the serving slice off, or uninstalling a release that carries it, no longer leaves `kserve-runtime-configs` `UninstallFailed` or its configs terminating** (giantswarm/agent-platform#527). The llm-d controller (`kserve-llmisvc-resources`) puts `serving.kserve.io/llmisvcconfig-finalizer` on every well-known `LLMInferenceServiceConfig`, is the only thing that clears it, and its webhook denies every delete of such a config while it runs; Helm deleted both child `HelmRelease`s in one pass, so the configs' uninstall was denied, or the configs were left terminating for the next slice to adopt and lose (`ConfigNotFound`). A hook Job `<release>-serving-teardown` (weight -2, the helm image, as `<release>-hooks`, with the engine and without it) now removes them in order: the controller's release, waited for until its Deployment and the webhook configuration are gone; the configs of `kserve-runtime-configs`, deleted through the CRD's storage version with the finalizer taken off; then the configs' release. It runs at pre-delete while both components are on, and at pre-upgrade when `components.kserve-runtime-configs` goes off while its live `HelmRelease` is the release's (a `lookup`). Switching `kserve-runtime-configs` off while `kserve-llmisvc-resources` stays on is refused with the reason. Not with `gitops.target.kubeConfig`: cluster-manager tears its slices down in this order itself. `make verify-serving-teardown` asserts the renders and runs the script against a stub kubectl. README "Uninstalling".
